name: speech-bubble
title: Speech Bubble
description: Manga speech bubble drawn in SVG at its real size and inscribed in its box, with real text inside. Variants: speech, thought (cloud), shout (spikes), whisper (dashed), narration (caption box), electronic (zigzag), wobbly (trembling). The tail points to top, bottom, start or end, aligned start/center/end, or none, and its room is reserved as margin. BubbleGroup chains bubbles through a neck that hides both outlines.

meta.tagline: Seven bubble shapes drawn at their real size.
meta.usage:
import { SpeechBubble, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<SpeechBubble variant="shout" tail="bottom" tailAlign="end">Get down!</SpeechBubble>
